title: Band members at the time of his marriage; the Hennessy killing
summary: Laine lists the men in his band when he married and says it was the same boyhood band at the time of the Hennessy lynching.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Let me get everything. Right. Papa, who was in your band when you got married about that time? Who was in your band when you got married? When I got married? Mm-hmm.
Manuel Marlowe, Leo Marlowe, Robbie Kirsch, Martin Kirsch, Gussie Zinneman, and the Chinaman, and... Was that King Martin? Yeah. Kit Martin, Vega, Buck A., and the Shields.
So many of them. I couldn't remember. Yeah. Well, do you remember when Dave Hennessy got killed? He was the chief of police? Oh, yes.
Well, who was in your band then? My band then?

I had that same band when we was kids. One of us kids, yeah. Same band. Same band as when you were kids? Yeah. Who was that? Playing piccoloos and stuff like that. Oh, yeah. When he killed Steve Hennessy, when he went and got them dagos out of prison, you mean? Yeah. And lynched them. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.

Young sir, regular young sir, Ed. Mm-hmm. Papa, I want to ask you about that political meeting again. Did you have a name for your band when you played that political meeting? No, just Lane's Band, that's all. Lane's Band. We call it Lane's Band.
We wasn't married by that Dave.
